instruction: Rename the 'Mkt Tera' sheet tab to 'Market Tera' in the opened spreadsheet.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent read reminder.docx to get sheet reordering requirements. Successfully moved ReadMe to position 1, Raw_data to position 2, and Beans to position 3. Then struggled with imprecise tab dragging coordinates for remaining sheets and ran out of 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open/read documents in LibreOffice Writer, navigate between sheets in LibreOffice Calc, drag sheet tabs with some imprecision, use File > Open dialogs, switch between applications, interact with sheet tabs
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed to complete full 10-sheet reorder due to imprecise screen coordinate targeting for tab drag-and-drop operations. Ran out of turns (50) with many sheets still misplaced.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single sheet rename operation. Model demonstrated ability to interact with sheet tabs (clicking, dragging). Renaming via right-click context menu is simpler than drag-and-drop reordering.
metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming the 'Mkt Tera' sheet to 'Market Tera'. Evaluator reads sheet names and checks that old name is gone and new name is present, with partial credit (0.5 for new name present, 0.5 for old name gone).

scoring_breakdown.old_name_gone: 0.5 - 'Mkt Tera' no longer in sheet names

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads sheet names from the xlsx file using openpyxl after downloading from VM
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('old_name') and expected.get('new_name') without wrapping
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads, ensuring fresh state
Complete coverage: instruction requires renaming one sheet, evaluator checks both old name removal and new name presence
Partial credit scoring (0.5 + 0.5) is logical and well-structured for a rename operation
Expected values ('Mkt Tera' and 'Market Tera') match the instruction exactly
